reels.title: M42 KEEPY
reels.caption:
Saving it isn't doing it. ⚽

Same ball, two plans. One practices 10 minutes a day. One saves freestyle videos. Day 30, he drops it again. Next day, he kicks again. A year later: 200 touches vs 912 saved videos.

Listen to the rhythm change.

Send this to someone who saves everything.

#football #keepyuppy #practice #discipline #motivation

reels.title: M43 BOKS
reels.yt_title: You don't get fast by watching fast. #Shorts
reels.caption:
You don't get fast by watching fast. 🥊

Same dream, two plans. One hits the bag 10 minutes a day. One watches fights. Day 30, out of breath. Next day, he hits again. A year later: 180 punches a minute vs 912 fights watched.

Listen to the combos get faster.

Send this to someone who says "I could do that."

#boxing #practice #discipline #habits #motivation
